name: zinput_di_reset_transition_state
description: zInput::DI_ResetTransitionState clears joystick button transition bytes and resets current/previous POV state when joystick input is initialized.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zInput joystick source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja's HLIL renders the paired POV loop with a negative-index artifact; assembly confirms parallel current/previous rgdwPOV stores.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x472410 validates the initialized guard, clearing joystick button bytes 1..10 in current and previous state, and resetting current/previous rgdwPOV[0..3] to 0xffff.
The native smoke verifies the joystick transition and POV state after ResetAllTransitionState delegates to DI_ResetTransitionState.
